title: Uniform refined Milnor–Wood inequality for simple tube-type Hermitian targets
author: Chaput, Pierre-Emmanuel; Maubon, Julien
work: Maximal representations of cocompact complex hyperbolic lattices, a uniform approach
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 6 (2019), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.93
difficulty_reason: Uniform cominuscule root calculations construct a graded nilpotent Higgs submodule with arithmetic-progression character slopes. Its saturated leafwise Higgs sheaf gives a rank-sensitive foliated Milnor-Wood bound; full-rank Higgs iteration and semistability of symmetric cotangent powers yield the stricter tube-type estimate.
